name: Indian Flappers
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: sifted Indian meal
ingredients.originalText: a pint of sifted Indian meal

instructions.text: Have ready a pint of sifted Indian meal, mixed with a handful of wheat flour, and a small tea-spoonful of salt.
Beat four eggs very light, and stir them by degrees into a quart of milk, in turn with the meal.
They can be made in a very short time, and should be baked as soon as mixed, on a hot griddle; allow a large ladle full of batter to each cake, and make them all of the same size.
Send them to table hot, buttered and cut in half.

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Have ready a pint of sifted Indian meal, mixed with a handful of wheat flour, and a small tea-spoonful of salt.
2. Beat four eggs very light, and stir them by degrees into a quart of milk, in turn with the meal.
3. They can be made in a very short time, and should be baked as soon as mixed, on a hot griddle; allow a large ladle full of batter to each cake, and make them all of the same size.
4. Send them to table hot, buttered and cut in half.
